description: Let \(M,N\) be nonempty first-order structures and \(\bar a,\bar b\) finite tuples of the same length. If every existential formula true in \(N\) at \(\bar b\) is true in \(M\) at \(\bar a\), there are a nonempty structure \(C\), an elementary embedding \(j:M\to C\), and an embedding \(f:N\hookrightarrow C\) with \(f(b_i)=j(a_i)\) at every coordinate.
